# Uploads

## Library files

1. `POST /api/records/upload-url` with `{ name, mime, size }`.
2. PUT the file bytes to the returned `uploadUrl`.
3. `POST /api/records` with `kind: "upload"`, `fileKey`, `name`, `mime` and
   `size`.
4. Poll extraction status if the document needs OCR or transcription.
5. Ask or read once the document is searchable.

Limits: regular records up to 500 MB.

## Course video

Instructors upload course video from the instructor app. The file goes
directly to storage, and encoding is queued and asynchronous: a video becomes
playable once encoding completes, so do not assume immediate playback. See
[Course media](/docs/build/media).
